title: AI Document Interpreter
description: Drop a PDF and get an interpretation: what the document is, a plain-language summary, the key points, and the fields worth extracting — the model reads it on AI deploys, and the sandbox produces a deterministic reading of the real text for free.

theme.$comment: A reading room on a pure-black ground (the recent achromatic restyle, preserved verbatim as the seed): two panes, white lamp-light held to a whisper, no hue anywhere — the document is the only color. The palette's dark values are the page's pre-AppShell art constants so the shell chrome and the room read as one surface; the light values are the same room with the blinds open. The shell defaults to minimal because the tool is one screen with nothing to navigate — its old chrome was a wordmark and a status chip; content is flush so the two panes keep owning the viewport's height.
